stops.text: 1. Navigate to https://apps.ankiweb.net/ and click *Download*
2. Select your correct OS version and click to begin the download
3. Click on the installer to begin the process
4. Click through the installer wizard
5. Hit Finish, and Launch *Anki*
5. Select your *language*, and confirm
1. Click the *Sync* button on the top action bar
2. Enter in your account details, if it is your first time using Anki, click *sign up*
3. Follow the online sign up flow, and validate your email with Anki
4. Return to Anki, and enter in your credentials (if the dialog disappeared, press sync again)
5. Press OK to verify your credentails. Anki will now try to sync!
6. To sync again in the future, (save your Anki or pull latest version) press *Sync* as needed
1. Select the *gear icon* on any deck
2. Select the *"Options"* tab
3. Scroll down to the FSRS section
4. Select Optimize Current Presets
5. If you have existing reviews, your FSRS will retrain on your data. Hit Ok.
6. Save your new training data to apply changes
1. Select the *gear icon* on the deck you want to rename
2. Select the *"Rename"* option
3. Enter in your new deck name
4. Click Ok
1. Select *'Add'* in the top bar
2. Change your note type to *'Image Occlusion'* by selecting the type box
3. Select Choose
4. Copy a diagram/picture to your clipboard
5. Return to Anki and click *'Paste Image from Clipboard'*
5. Return to Anki and click *'Paste Image from Clipboard'*
6. Make sure the *rectangle tool* is selected on the sidebar
8. Click and drag to draw rectangles over the information you are testing
9. Click and drag existing rectangles to resize/reposition them
10. Click *Add* and return to the main screen
11. Study your cards
